sections.title: Product Highlights
bullets: The most compact 3C node on the market with internal orthogonal high-sensitivity geophones (5Hz or 10Hz);
Three channels of 24-bit Δ-Σ ADC with configurable preamplifier gain and sampling rate;
Highly sensitive GNSS module equipped with active patch antenna supports GPS, Beidou, and GLONASS;

Built-in test signal generator supports on-site full signal chain function and performance self-inspection and diagnosis, including system noise, real-time dynamic range, geophone impedance, natural frequency, sensitivity, damping, distortion, etc.;
Built-in BLE module together with LEDs for on-site configuration and proximity, supports vehicle (20 meters) or UAV (100 meters) patrol;
Industrial Android handheld tablet supports working status verification after deployment, including battery usage, environmental temperature, tilting, GNSS status, real-time seismic waveform, etc.;
P&R (Place & Record) mode for rapid and convenient field deployment, supporting automatic GNSS position matching with line and point number;
High-strength engineering plastic enclosure for enhanced drop resistance, waterproof (IP68), flame retardant (5VA), ultraviolet aging (F1).
